---
type: ambition
title: build a creative life i'm proud of
tags: [bangkok, freedom]
---
i want work that is mine and a life with room to breathe. i keep planning the
move and not starting it — drafting the same notes about quitting, about a
studio of my own, about finally making something that feels like me. this is
the year i actually make the move instead of rehearsing it. a creative life of
my own, on my own terms.
